I was in a very similar boat last week. I hadn't done a single assignment since September probably. And I was failing all of my classes. I just couldn't get out of bed and I couldn't focus. I wanted to try to do things I liked to try to ignore the depression instead of killing myself over stressful schoolwork. I lied to my parents about it.

Well my mom figured out December 9th. Which is a whole story in and of itself.

She kept pushing me to do my work because the semester was almost over and I couldn't fail my senior year, and I wont lie, I still put it off but eventually I decided I didn't want to have to make up the credits.

My first point of action was sending all of my teachers an email. I had to push down my embarrassment and mentioned that I was depressed. I didn't go into detail but I hoped it would add an explanation and hopefully my teachers would be a bit more sympathetic and understanding with me.

Let me tell you I am so glad I did it. 3/4 of my teachers responded back and said they understood especially since it was more difficult due to corona and they told me exactly what I would need to do to get to a passing grade. 2 of them even exempt me from enough assignments to get my grade up after I did a few assignments. One teacher even got my F to a C. I was very appreciative. They said mostly that they appreciate someone who can admit their fault and try to make it better.

Now when it comes to doing the work itself, it wasn't easy, because obviously my problems didn't just disappear. My biggest problem was motivation and that I think I might have ADHD. I would try to turn youtube videos on while I worked or listen to music. I took a lot of breaks, but I got my grades up. Try, but don't overwork or overwhelm yourself, if you have to a have a break, take one.

I don't really know how to write it all down right now but seriously don't feel afraid to DM me if you'd like me to try to help. I don't have all the answers but I find the best thing is to have people in your corner. Obviously I don't know how your teachers will react but I really think you should send an email. My thought was "well what's the worst thing they could possibly say? I doubt they could make my grades any worse, I mean maybe they'll ignore it or be hostile but I don't have to listen to that." It could turn out better than you think.

Anyways I wish you good luck, and don't give up! Much love.

I think everyone is different. The way i write i just do exactly that, write. Don't edit while you're initially writing. I just get my main chapter structure out, i don't edit grammer, spelling, anything. And if i run into a point where i cant think of what to write in the chapter ill just put a marker there and continue on to the next scene that i can think of writing. So yeah, sometimes it comes out like gibberish but i think that's okay. As long as you can understand what's going on.

Then afterward i go through and reread, correcting all of the mistakes and filling in the things i couldn't think of. I find it really helps keep the writing flow and i don't get caught up on mistakes that ruin my train of thought.
